description: Third separately authored held-out set, written 2026-11-24 for the v0.2 (explicit out-of-scope class) milestone. Fresh phrasings, disjoint from heldout.json v1, heldout-v2.json and every synthetic split, and authored BEFORE any v0.2 run so no v0.2 behavior shaped the cases. Same honest limit as v1/v2: the author had seen the v1 and v2 failure analyses, so once v0.2's results on this set inform future iterations it becomes a development benchmark too. tier=core: phrasings close to the documented spec that engines should handle. tier=stretch: plausible user wording beyond the current spec; misses here are product gaps, not engine bugs. refuse=true: a correct engine declines. The refuse cases probe generalization: six rephrase trained out-of-scope categories with unseen vocabulary, three are untrained categories, one is gibberish; none matches a training template verbatim.
